rapport_notes: Amy is warm, personable, and genuinely present throughout; voice tone is friendly and unhurried, customer comfort evident.
process_discipline_notes: No repeated differentiators; no silence violations detected — rep moved naturally through conversation without artificial pausing breaches.

evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Let me know if you have any questions or what are you most worried about for the upcoming move? Wanna make sure we cover every day on this call.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised only logistical questions (branch contact, one-day feasibility, elevator impact), never personal concerns requiring two-layer follow-up.

evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: But of course we're hourly based. So, you're not bombed by the estimate. Basically you only pay for the actual time to use
evidence_quotes.missing_sheet1: Never asked 'What items do you need us to be most careful with?' or mentioned damage coverage/care framing.
evidence_quotes.missing_sheet2: Never mentioned 'Meet Your Mover' or who specifically will be showing up.
evidence_quotes.missing_sheet5: No 'commit to the rate' framing, no 'beats it, you pay less' explanation, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' close with silence.
evidence_quotes.missing_close: No rate-lock line ('your rate locks when you book') and no explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'). Call ended with 'is there anything else' / customer saying 'that's all' and rep saying 'thank you,' but no booking commitment sought.

top_strength: Amy delivered a clear, personalized estimate with strong anchoring (local comparison + drive time + floor factors) and articulated the hourly-rate model transparently, reducing customer anxiety about overages.
coaching_note: Stage 1 agenda was asked too late (after logistics probing started), and the call completely skipped the two critical differentiators (damage coverage and Meet Your Mover) in either stage, leaving money on the table and no close attempted — prioritize the agenda-opening sequence and ensure all four takeaway differentiators land before or during Stage 2.
